# Introduction

`eulob` provides offline access to EU-LOB, a catalogue of names
and entries from European lobbying and transparency registers.

The catalogue contains 19 territorial scopes and 21 registers.
Its entries should not automatically be interpreted as unique
legal organizations.

# Load the package

```{r}
library(eulob)
eulob_version()
```

# Explore countries and registers

List territorial coverage and available registers.

```{r}
head(eulob_countries())
head(eulob_registers())
```

The code `UE` represents the supranational EU Transparency
Register and is not an ISO country code.

Filter the catalogue by country:

```{r}
eulob_registers(country = "IT")
eulob_sources(country = "ES")
```

`eulob_sources()` reports register-level counts using the
existing catalogue indexes.

# Retrieve lobbying register entries

`eulob_lobbies()` returns names and identifiers from the
selected territorial scope or register.

```{r}
spanish <- eulob_lobbies(country = "ES")
head(spanish, 5)
```

An individual entry can be retrieved by its source-specific
identifier:

```{r}
if (nrow(spanish) > 0L) {
  entry <- spanish[1L, ]
  head(eulob_get(
    country = entry$country,
    lobby_id = entry$lobby_id,
    register = entry$register
  ))
}
```

# Search for organization names

The default search uses cosine similarity over character
bigrams:

```{r}
head(eulob_search("association", limit = 5))
head(eulob_search("universidad", country = "ES", limit = 5))
```

For case-insensitive literal substring matching, select
`method = "fixed"`:

```{r}
head(eulob_search(
  "universidad",
  method = "fixed",
  limit = 5
))
```

Additional approximate name-search methods include Jaccard,
Jaro-Winkler and Damerau-Levenshtein.

These methods compare text, not semantic representations or
verified legal identities.

# Search normalized-name candidates

`eulob_search_normalized()` searches a separate bundled
candidate index.

It supports three modes:

- `strict`: strict normalized-name candidates.
- `exploratory`: exploratory candidate matching.
- `both`: both candidate categories.

```{r}
head(eulob_search_normalized(
  "association",
  method = "strict",
  limit = 5
))
```

Candidate results are intended to assist manual assessment.
They are not evidence of verified legal identity.

# Find shared names across registers

`eulob_cross_registers()` identifies names appearing across
multiple territorial scopes.

```{r}
head(eulob_cross_registers(
  min_countries = 2L,
  limit = 5L
))
```

Names appearing in several registers are not necessarily
the same legal organization.

# Understand identifiers

The catalogue distinguishes:

- `name_id`: identifier for a normalized name.
- `name_normalized`: normalized name representation.
- `name`: recorded name.
- `country`: territorial or supranational scope.
- `register`: source register.
- `lobby_id`: register-specific identifier.

Some register identifiers originate from official registration
systems; others are derived from source records.

Identifiers should always be interpreted within their
corresponding register.

# Reproducibility

The bundled catalogue can be queried without an internet
connection. Record the package version, search methods and
filters used in any analysis.

```{r}
eulob_info()
eulob_version()
```

For details on the indexing structure and methodological
limitations, see *Understanding the EU-LOB Catalogue*.
